development.text: Oil changes a sabji more than the vegetable does: bhindi fry is {{A}}, stuffed bhindi is {{B}}.

production.text: Oil changes a sabji more than the vegetable does: cooked okra is {{A}} with fat added and {{B}} without.

development.text: A dry sabji keeps the oil low: dry aloo is {{A}}, aloo in gravy is {{B}}.

production.text: A dry sabji usually carries less oil than one in gravy.

development.text: Mix a starchy vegetable with a fibre-rich one, such as aloo with gobhi or methi.

development.text: Use a little oil for the whole dish, and add flavour with jeera, haldi, dhania and chilli instead.
